title: Add a comment on its own line
instruction: Add a comment on the **first line** that says **# This program prints numbers**. The code below should still print 10 and 20 as before.
starter_code:
# Add a comment on this line
print(10)
print(20)
solution_code:
# This program prints numbers
print(10)
print(20)

title: Add an inline comment
instruction: Add an **inline comment** at the end of the print statement. The comment should explain that this prints a greeting.

title: Comment out a line
instruction: The code below has two print statements. **Comment out the first one** so only the second line runs.
starter_code:
print("This should not run")
print("This should run")
solution_code:
# print("This should not run")
print("This should run")

title: Explain your code with a comment
instruction: Write a print statement that prints **Learning Python is fun!** and add a comment on the line above that explains the purpose of the code.
solution_code:
# Tell the user Python is fun
print("Learning Python is fun!")

test_cases.expected_output: # Tell the user Python is fun

title: Add a TODO comment
instruction: Write a comment that says **TODO: Add more features later** on a line above a print that says **Hello, world!**.
solution_code:
# TODO: Add more features later
print("Hello, world!")
